trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped depression centered between lobes with a pixel depth of approximately 8-12 pixels relative to the surrounding lobe crests.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular pixel variations (serrations) along the entire trailing edge boundary, characterized by jagged 1-3 pixel peaks against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature following a parabolic path from the median notch to the distal rounded tips.
